title: A chain build on an EmDash release takes its template kit from the kit index at the site's release and version
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The kit step of a run with no sealing profile reads the site row once and answers the kit tracy-diner/emdash-0.x/0.1.4 with platform emdash and its content map; a run with a profile keeps that kit without reading the site; a release the kit index does not know still stops with "no readable template kit for <release>".

tests: an EmDash run with no sealing profile takes the kit and content map of the site release
a run that carries its profile keeps that kit and never reads the site; an unknown release still stops
